name: Mario Kart 8 Deluxe dual screen
_contract: Values published by the module 0100152000022000: mk.* (race context, course / cup names and image keys, horn state), me.* (local player), r0..r11.* (per racer: rank, icon, name, items, map position, finished); module glue: mk.pict_ok / mk.cup_ok / mk.fit_img / mk.map_img / mk.name_ok, mk.course_name_w, r{i}.name_scale; card-swap animation r{i}.row_y / r{i}.row_dx (displayed row position / drift, row units) / r{i}.row_glow, rk.flip. mk.mock comes only from the DEV mock.
_design: v3 (0.4.0, runtime 13): flags ui.map / ui.dark / ui.long; derived ui.pg picks the page (mode x theme); the row format is an anim group on each race page; holds (on_hold) toggle theme / format.
_swap: card-swap animation: cards at r{i}.row_y / r{i}.row_dx (module); overtake 150 ms ease-out with a 0.3-row drift + glow on the overtaking card; 3+ cards moving = pile-up, 100 ms, no drift; the number column and the local number cell stay on the exact ranks.

mk.use_item._note: L = the game's 'Use item' button (verified live)

mk.horn._note: no horn button in 4.0.0 (action mask 8 = 0): the module's guarded direct write (mk.horn_ok / mk.horn_busy / mk.horn_count)

ui.theme._note: press-and-hold on the horn / map panel (on_hold); haptic = hold

ui.format._note: press-and-hold on the ranking (on_hold); haptic = hold
